title: Megaworld Foundation Scholarship 2026-2027 Application Guide
description: Applications for the Megaworld Foundation Scholarship Program are now open for the first semester of School Year 2026–2027. The scholarship supports academically deserving students from financially challenged families by providing educational assistance and opportunities for personal, professional, and career development. This Megaworld Foundation Scholarship 2026–2027 guide covers the qualifications, requirements, benefits, accepted courses, partner schools, application deadline, and online application process to help interested students prepare their applications. Applicants for the Megaworld Foundation Scholarship 2026–2027 must satisfy the initial qualifications announced by Megaworld Foundation. Before applying, make sure that you meet the following conditions: The scholarship requirements published by the Foundation cover incoming freshmen, sophomores, and juniors. Applicants must also meet the academic and enrollment conditions applicable to their incoming year level. Meeting the initial qualifications does not automatically guarantee a scholarship. Applicants who pass the initial screening may be required to submit additional documents and undergo interviews for further evaluation.

education.raw_text: The scholarship requirements published by the Foundation cover incoming freshmen, sophomores, and juniors.

other_requirements: Be a resident near a Megaworld township or project.
Have parents whose combined gross annual income does not exceed ₱400,000.
Have a general average of at least 85% or its equivalent.
Have a grade of at least 80% in every subject.
Be enrolled in an accepted degree program at a Megaworld Foundation partner school.
All grade reports from previous semesters through the current semester, showing a GPA of at least 85% or its equivalent and no grade below 80% in any subject

requirements: Barangay Certificate of Residency of the applicant
Proof of the parents’ financial capacity, whichever is applicable:
Photograph of the applicant with their family or guardian
Latest utility bills, such as electricity, water, rent, telephone, or internet bills
Complete final senior high school grade report showing an average of at least 85% or its equivalent, with no grade below 80% in any subject
Passing university entrance examination result, letter of admission, certificate of enrollment, or registration form
Certificate showing that the applicant belongs to the upper 10% of the graduating class or branch, if available
Full-load enrollment assessment or registration form with class schedule
Complete and most updated course curriculum
